function.name: sports_ranking_get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is required.

message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the 2003 Mr. Basketball America and led his team to a state championship.

He entered the NBA as the first overall pick in the 2003 draft and has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (2003–2010, 2014–2018), Miami Heat (2010–2014), and Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present). LeBron has won four NBA championships (2007, 2012, 2013, 2020), earned four NBA Most Valuable Player awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013), and has been selected to the All‑NBA First Team 17 times. He has also earned 13 All‑Star selections and has been named the NBA Finals MVP four times.

Beyond the court, LeBron is known for his philanthropy, notably the LeBron James Family Foundation, which opened the “I’m‑a‑STEM” school in Akron. He has also pursued business ventures, including a partnership with Nike, a production company (SpringHill Entertainment), and ownership stakes in media outlets such as Blaze Media. His activism includes speaking out on social justice issues and supporting voting rights initiatives.
